paragraph_requires: For the years ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025 , there were no outstanding instruments which were potentially dilutive
decisions.reader_note: For Emerson Radio’s years ended March 31, 2025 and 2026, the filing explicitly states there were no outstanding potentially dilutive instruments. Its basic and diluted weighted-average shares are identical; this is a stated absence of instruments, not an inferred loss-period exclusion. Full share counts, reported EPS and March fiscal dates remain unchanged.

paragraph_requires: Basic earnings (loss) per common share are computed by dividing net income (loss)
All dollars, except earnings per share, presented on this Form 10-K are in thousands
decisions.reader_note: For Reliability in 2024 and 2025, the statement reports basic and diluted EPS as $0.00 despite net losses, with 300 million weighted-average shares for each measure. The displayed zero values are retained and do not mean the company broke even. The filing describes the basic EPS calculation but does not establish a specific reason for basic and diluted shares being equal. This review confirms the reported presentation only; it does not infer that no potentially dilutive instruments existed.
